verdict.rationale: Tailscale's docs explicitly claim infrastructure access to resources wherever they live, including Kubernetes clusters, with auditable access to SSH, K8s and databases across clouds or on-prem. They also document a Kubernetes sidecar deployment and subnet routers for reaching private services, and community users report reaching dev servers and production bastions without public exposure. missing for 10: detailed docs on Kubernetes-native access (e.g., an operator or API-server proxy, plus K8s access control), and independent hands-on corroboration of Kubernetes access beyond a vendor-site testimonial.
